title: Deferred Fixed Annuities Rate Note: Withdrawal History Adjustment to Part-Year Surrender Interest
content:
The withdrawal record of an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract over the two years before its surrender adjusts the rate of the part-year surrender interest.

## Rule

The withdrawal history adjustment to the part-year surrender interest rate is:

- an **addition of 0.10% (0.001)** where no withdrawal other than a required minimum distribution was taken from the contract in the **24** months before the handling date;
- a **deduction of 0.10% (0.001)** where an excess partial withdrawal was taken from the contract in those months;
- nothing otherwise.

The adjustment is made to the rate at which the part-year surrender interest is worked. Withdrawals are read from the contract's activity history, where each is classed (required minimum distribution, excess partial withdrawal, and so on).

## Judgement table (withdrawals in the 24 months before the handling date)

| Withdrawals found | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| None at all | Addition of 0.10% |
| Only required minimum distributions | Addition of 0.10% |
| At least one excess partial withdrawal, with or without others | Deduction of 0.10% |
| Other withdrawals (for example a waiver withdrawal), none of them an excess partial withdrawal | Nothing |

## Worked cases (hypothetical, rate before adjustment 5.30%)

- Only two required minimum distributions in the period: 5.40%.
- One excess partial withdrawal 20 months before the handling date: 5.20%.
- An excess partial withdrawal 30 months before the handling date and nothing since: it falls outside the 24 months, so 5.40%.
